what_changed: The Stellar Phoenix is the default hull and, for the first time, is actually inside the package. Every previous build shipped the classic hull: the ship is loaded by string path, so the cooker never followed it, and Installed() answered false with no error and no log line.
Six content roots reached a package for the first time - the ship and its effects, the station props, both station staff, the electrical-storm beams and the alien gallery levels.
The ship carries the parts its pack ships: both engine nacelle meshes, the pack effect rig at its authored transforms, its onboard point light, its camera rig and the wings-out flight pose.
The crosshair is a world point ahead of the hull rather than screen centre, and aim and the sight trace both follow it from the muzzle.

open_defects: Issue 53: exhaust emitters are world-space, so plumes smear sideways at flight speed.
Issue 54: the cargo door receives no fill light in deep space and reads as a black hole.
Issue 55: DockClearanceAboveDeck has no readers, so the ship parks about 2.3 m above the pad.
Issue 49: BP_Spaceship does not compile in this project; reparenting it is proposed but unproven.
Issue 56: this release fixed cook coverage; the check is a report and is not yet wired into the gate.
authorization: The owner asked for the critical fixes and a republish, and confirmed the itch channel is an alpha for one tester who needs the latest build, bugs included.
limitations: No owner gameplay acceptance: the owner has not flown this build.
Rendered fixtures are scripted, assert no frame rate, and are not natural play.
